一、后缀 -ous（充满……的 / 具有……性质的）

核心逻辑：充满了该词根所代表的特质。

Enormous | 词根 norm（标准）| 雅思例句：The internet has exerted an enormous impact on global communication.

Precarious | 词根 prec（祈祷/恳求）| 雅思例句：Gig workers often live in precarious conditions without job security.

Indigenous | 词根 gen（出生/起源）| 雅思例句：Protecting indigenous languages is crucial for cultural diversity.

Scrupulous | 词根 scrup（尖石子）| 雅思例句：A scrupulous researcher double-checks all data before publication.

Fabulous | 词根 fabul（故事/传说）| 雅思例句：The view from the mountain top was absolutely fabulous.

Fatuous | 词根 fatu（空洞的）| 雅思例句：His fatuous remarks added nothing to the serious debate.

二、后缀 -able / -ible（值得……的 / 能够……的）

核心逻辑：词根的动作可以被施加到该词上。

Delectable | 词根 lect（挑选）| 雅思例句：The city is famous for its delectable street food.

Viable | 词根 viv（生命/活）| 雅思例句：Solar energy is now a viable alternative to fossil fuels.

三、后缀 -ent / -ant（具有……性质的）

核心逻辑：处于词根所描述的状态中。

Significant | 词根 sign（标记）+ fic（做）| 雅思例句：There is a significant correlation between pollution and respiratory diseases.

Constant | 词根 st（站立）| 雅思例句：The constant connectivity of smartphones blurs work-life boundaries.

Dominant | 词根 domin（统治）| 雅思例句：English remains the dominant language in international business.

Predominant | 词根 domin（统治）| 雅思例句：The predominant reason for migration is economic opportunity.

Convenient | 词根 ven（来）| 雅思例句：Online banking is a convenient way to manage personal finances.

四、后缀 -ive（倾向……的 / 有……作用的）

核心逻辑：倾向于发出词根所表示的动作。

Compulsive | 词根 puls（推）| 雅思例句：Excessive social media use can develop into compulsive behaviour.

Effective | 词根 fect（做）| 雅思例句：Education is the most effective tool to combat inequality.

Massive | 词根 mass（块/堆）| 雅思例句：The project required a massive amount of capital investment.

五、后缀 -al（与……有关的）

核心逻辑：与词根所代表的事物相关。

Rational | 词根 ratio（计算/推理）| 雅思例句：Consumers do not always make rational decisions; emotions play a big role.

Hereditary | 词根 hered（继承人）| 雅思例句：Some diseases are hereditary, while others are triggered by lifestyle.

Traditional | 词根 trad（交出/传承）| 雅思例句：Traditional diets are often healthier than processed foods.

六、后缀 -ory / -ary（与……相关的 / 倾向于……的）

核心逻辑：属于该范畴或用于该用途。

Compulsory | 词根 puls（推）| 雅思例句：Physical education should be compulsory in all schools.

Sanitary | 词根 san（健康）| 雅思例句：Providing sanitary living conditions is a basic government responsibility.

七、后缀 -ic（属于……的 / 具有……特征的）

核心逻辑：具有该学科或该时代的鲜明特征。

Archaic | 词根 arch（开始/起源）| 雅思例句：The country's legal system is archaic and needs urgent reform.

Phonetic | 词根 phon（声音）| 雅思例句：Using phonetic symbols helps learners master pronunciation.

终极词根串串烧（强化记忆）

看到 norm（标准）→ 超过标准就是 enormous。

看到 domin（统治）→ 统治他人是 dominant，超过所有人是 predominant。

看到 puls（推）→ 外界推你是 compulsory（强制），内心推你是 compulsive（冲动）。

看到 gen（出生）→ 本地出生是 indigenous，研究出生是 genetics（遗传学）。

终极口诀

-ous 充满特质多，-able 值得又能做，

-ent/-ant 状态稳，-ive 倾向跑不脱，

-al/-ory 相关事，雅思写作靠它活！
